explication: Smithay is a modular Rust library for building Wayland compositors, not a complete window manager. A compositor integrates protocol globals and platform backends; Wayland clients submit surface content and requests, input backends provide events, and rendering backends compose buffers for display. The tree also includes desktop, popup, selection, XWayland, and nested-development helpers. Some wiring is documented rather than sampled directly, so those subsystems are shown without speculative call edges.
